description: Issue #308 baseline: 24MP (6000x4000) Q90 4:2:0 photo-like rot90 via transform_jpeg_with_options(copy_markers=All), portable release build (no -C target-cpu), AMD EPYC 9554 (Zen 4), examples/bench_transform.rs 10 iters. Stage split: read_coefficients 100.8ms / to_natural 11.9ms / spatial 66.8ms / to_zigzag 12.7ms / write 46.5ms.

Dim-swap ops (transpose/rot90/rot270/transverse) seeded new_blocks with vec![0]+copy_from_slice then overwrote every block via new_blocks2 — pure waste (~576MB traffic on 24MP). Allocate once, write directly; mirror ops seed with clone(). Spatial stage 66.8->30.0ms, total 259.6->229.8ms (-11.5%).

Fused zigzag<->natural round-trip into the spatial op via const ZigzagMap tables (composition is again a permutation+sign). Spatial stage 54.6ms (30 + 11.9 + 12.7 combined) -> 53.5ms fused; eliminates two whole-corpus passes (576MB traffic). Total 232.7 vs 229.8 within read_coefficients codegen-layout jitter (+-8% across builds, see huffman.tsv d40302e note); kept for the traffic elimination + simpler single-mechanism structure. Const maps pinned against do_* kernels by spatial::tests::zigzag_maps_match_natural_kernels.

16x16 block tiling of the dim-swap scatter loops, because the rot90 write pattern strides new_bx*128B per inner step; failed because tiling also broke the src side's pure-sequential hardware prefetch — spatial 53.5->58-64ms. The scatter is latency-bound, not reuse-bound, at this working-set size.
